name: Sports Academy
description: Train at world-class stadiums and unlock champion mascots!

reward.name: Golden Boot Lion
reward.fact: The FIFA World Cup has been held every four years since 1930. Brazil has won it the most times — five!

reward.name: Turbo Dolphin
reward.fact: Olympic swimming pools are exactly 50 metres long and hold about 2.5 million litres of water.

reward.name: Sprint Cheetah
reward.fact: Usain Bolt's world record 100m time is 9.58 seconds. He reached a top speed of 27.8 miles per hour!

reward.name: Ice Bear
reward.fact: Figure skaters can spin at over 300 revolutions per minute — that's five full spins every second!

reward.name: Rally Hawk
reward.fact: The longest tennis match in history lasted 11 hours and 5 minutes at Wimbledon in 2010.

reward.name: Century Fox
reward.fact: A cricket ball is harder than a baseball and can be bowled at over 100 miles per hour by fast bowlers.

reward.name: Pedal Panther
reward.fact: The Tour de France covers about 3,500 kilometres over 21 stages — that's like cycling from London to Morocco!

reward.name: Vault Tiger
reward.fact: Gymnasts experience forces of up to 14 times their own body weight when landing from a vault.

reward.name: Scrum Rhino
reward.fact: A rugby ball is oval-shaped so it's easier to carry while running. The Rugby World Cup trophy weighs 4.5 kilograms!

reward.name: Oar Otter
reward.fact: Olympic rowing boats can travel at over 20 kilometres per hour — that's faster than most people can run!

reward.name: Champion Gorilla
reward.fact: Boxing rounds last exactly 3 minutes each. A professional boxer can throw over 100 punches in a single round!

reward.name: Dive Falcon
reward.fact: Olympic divers enter the water at over 35 miles per hour from the 10-metre platform — that's only 3 seconds of freefall!

reward.name: Bullseye Robin
reward.fact: The centre of an archery target is just 12.2 centimetres wide. Olympic archers hit it from 70 metres away — the length of 2 swimming pools!

reward.name: Rapier Cat
reward.fact: Fencing is one of only five sports that has been in every modern Olympic Games since 1896. Touches are scored in milliseconds!

reward.name: Slam Dunk Kangaroo
reward.fact: A basketball hoop is exactly 3.05 metres high. The highest vertical jump ever recorded by an NBA player was 1.22 metres!

reward.name: Shuttle Swallow
reward.fact: A badminton shuttlecock can travel at over 300 miles per hour — making it the fastest object in any racket sport!

reward.name: Stick Leopard
reward.fact: Field hockey is played in over 100 countries. The ball can travel at 100 miles per hour when hit by a professional player!

reward.name: Spike Monkey
reward.fact: Beach volleyball was invented in California in the 1920s. Players can jump over a metre high to spike the ball!

reward.name: Ping Pong Hamster
reward.fact: A table tennis ball weighs just 2.7 grams — lighter than a 1p coin! Top players can spin it at 9,000 revolutions per minute.

reward.name: Summit Spider
reward.fact: Sport climbing became an Olympic event in 2020. Speed climbers can scale a 15-metre wall in under 5 seconds!

reward.name: Triathlon Turtle
reward.fact: A triathlon combines swimming, cycling, and running. The Ironman triathlon covers 226 kilometres — that takes about 8-17 hours!

reward.name: Power Bear
reward.fact: The world record for weightlifting is 267 kg — that's like lifting a baby elephant over your head!

reward.name: Kickflip Raccoon
reward.fact: Skateboarding became an Olympic sport in 2020. The youngest Olympic gold medallist in skateboarding was just 13 years old!

reward.name: Speed Cobra
reward.fact: F1 cars can go from 0 to 100 mph and back to 0 in under 5 seconds. Races are often won by just tenths of a second!

reward.name: Ace Eagle
reward.fact: The chances of making a hole-in-one in golf are about 1 in 12,500 — that's less than 0.01%!

reward.name: Champion Phoenix
reward.fact: The Olympic flame travels to the host city from Greece by relay. Over 12,000 torchbearers carried it for the London 2012 Games!

reward.name: Stats Parrot
reward.fact: In cricket, a batting average of 50.00 is considered world-class. Sir Don Bradman's average was an incredible 99.94!

reward.name: Sprint Hare
reward.fact: Olympic races are timed to the thousandth of a second. The 2008 men's 100m butterfly final was won by just 0.01 seconds!

reward.name: Ticket Mouse
reward.fact: The most expensive football match ticket ever sold was £100,000 for a Champions League final. Most fans pay between £30-£60!

reward.name: Trophy Tortoise
reward.fact: The FIFA World Cup trophy is made of 18-carat gold and weighs 6.1 kilograms. It's worth about £150,000 in gold alone!

reward.name: Transfer Eagle
reward.fact: The most expensive football transfer ever was £200 million. Clubs spend millions analysing player statistics before signing anyone!

reward.name: Gold Medal Dolphin
reward.fact: Olympic gold medals are actually 92.5% silver with a gold coating. The last solid gold medals were awarded in 1912!
